“We don’t need the SAVE America Act because illegal voting is against the law.”

That’s like saying we don’t need cops because crimes are already illegal.

Video

All states issue Drivers Licenses to non-citizens. 

19 states issue them to illegal immigrants.

Some have already legalized non-citizen voting at the local level. 

There are 30 million non-citizens in America. 

This is all headed in one direction. 

Unless we SAVE America.

Video

The only secret to passing the SAVE America Act is time and willpower. 

The Civil Rights Act of 1964 was passed after a 72 day filibuster. 

After only 6 days on the Senate floor, Democrats are already looking for an exit. 

Don’t let up.

Video

Voting is a constitutionally protected right. 

All the more reason to ensure it is exercised by AMERICANS ONLY. 

Those who say otherwise just want to cheat. It’s that simple.

Video
Senate Democrats just blocked legislation to keep men out of women’s sports.

False. We want both to be easy.

For law-abiding Americans.


Chuck Schumer (@SenSchumer)

MAGA Republicans want to make it harder to vote than to buy an AR-15.

They want Americans’ information run through an algorithm designed by Musk and DOGE that could kick eligible voters off the rolls.

They want to turn voter registration into a bureaucratic nightmare and limit how people can register.

That’s the SAVE Act, and that's why Democrats will fight it until the end.



— https://nitter.net/SenS

Americans are confronting the fact that they are being defrauded on an industrial scale, at home and abroad. 

That’s why I cosponsored the Payment Integrity Act to base childcare funds on actual attendance rather than claimed enrollment. It’s why I voted against funding USADF corruption and called for a federal investigation. It’s why I cosponsored the Deporting Fraudsters Act—which is exactly what it sounds like.

The outrages exposed in LA, Minneapolis, and across our country will not stop un

Chuck Schumer and other Democrats have insisted that they actually support Voter ID—they just object to other parts of the SAVE America Act. 

Well, @SenJonHusted just asked unanimous consent to pass ONLY the Voter ID portion of the bill. 

Democrats blocked it.

Video
The only place in America where proof of citizenship and voter ID are unpopular is the Senate Democratic Caucus.

Getting a job.
Driving a car.
Catching a flight.
Opening a bank account. 
Attending the Democratic National Convention. 

Americans need ID for all of these things.

Why not for voting in federal elections?
